citations.assessment: The intended Yehudah ben Levi entry names his son Menaḥem and identifies the Demai episode. The checked Yerushalmi has Yehudah send for his son to tithe the fruit.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
